cards.industry_contour: Universal / atmospheric air / emissions inventory / calculation methodologies / PEC
cards.primary_source: Rosprirodnadzor FAQ: legitimacy of emissions inventory calculations using methodologies and timing of their inclusion in the Minprirody list; Rosprirodnadzor 06.07.2026 seminar stressing completeness, timely updating and approved methodologies.
current_npa: Government Resolution No. 692 dated 21.05.2025, effective 01.09.2025 through 01.09.2031 (except clause 3)
cards.factual_pattern: TECHNOLOGY/SOURCE → CALCULATION METHOD → METHOD STATUS/DATE → EMISSION INVENTORY → PEC/NORMING → FACTUAL CONTROL → MISMATCH → INVENTORY CORRECTION
cards.risk: A formally prepared inventory may rest on a calculation method whose legal applicability is not checked against the official methodology list and relevant dates, or may no longer reflect actual emissions.
cards.evidence_practice: Rosprirodnadzor states that inventory results calculated by methods can be legitimate depending on the date relationship to inclusion of the method in the official list; in July 2026 the Service separately emphasized completeness, timely updating and use of approved methods.
cards.mirlex_checks: For every calculated source/substance: method name/version; official-list status; inclusion date; inventory date; scope applicability; input data; actual equipment/process mode; later PEC/lab data; need for correction.
cards.impact: Extend IND-AIR-001 and the MIRLEX Air audit with METHOD_VALIDITY_GATE and METHOD_DATE_GATE. Assistant must not accept a calculated inventory value without tracing the method and date.
cards.red_flag: Inventory contains calculated emissions but the enterprise cannot identify the exact method/version, prove its status/date in the official list, or show that the method applies to the actual equipment/process.
cards.update_required: IND-AIR-001 + METHOD_VALIDITY_GATE + METHOD_DATE_GATE + METHOD_SCOPE_MATCH + INPUT_DATA_TRACE + PEC_FEEDBACK → INVENTORY_CORRECTION
